# A small ABI root whose inspection schema uses every value form, for
# test/host/erx_schema_test.rb.
abi 1
include inspection.txt
limit width u32 40
limit inspect_reply_max u32 262144
status ok 0 "success"
status inval -1 "invalid argument"
right read 0 "read"
right write 1 "write"
type budget 1
  rights read,write
  pass read
type space 2
  rights read
  pass none
scalar page u64 range 0 1048576 align 4096
enum colour u32
  value red 1
  value blue 2
flags mode u32
  bit fast 0
  bit safe 1
